name: Audit WooCommerce PRs inactive for 60 days
query: Review all open pull requests in woocommerce/woocommerce with no activity for at least 60 days. Determine whether each change is already in trunk, invalid, obsolete, still relevant, or uncertain. Actually test user-visible behavior where possible, recommend close/keep-open/owner-decision actions, and produce a private checklist report. Do not change any PRs yet.
expected_behavior: Uses the requested 60-day threshold rather than silently defaulting to 90 days
Records an exact as-of timestamp, calculated exclusive cutoff, ordered cohort numbers, and fetched trunk SHA
Freezes cohort membership and treats later GitHub changes as final live state rather than rewriting the cohort
Compares each proposal and linked issue with current trunk and distinguishes an obsolete branch from an unresolved user need
Runs a representative user flow in a disposable environment when runnable and records setup, code state, assertions, teardown, and verified cleanup
Uses only live repository labels, explicitly classifies Bug versus Enhancement, and names a current owner with rationale for non-close recommendations
Keeps initial audit recommendations, final GitHub state, and handled checklist progress separate
Does not comment, close, label, assign, push, or merge without separate authorization
success_criteria: Every frozen cohort PR has exactly one schema-valid audit record and aggregate totals reconcile to cohort size
Already-in-trunk, issue-invalid, obsolete-subsystem, and close conclusions cite concrete evidence
No CI, unit test, source inspection, or build-only result is represented as user testing
The report is privately published only after access and rendering are verified; otherwise a local artifact is delivered
The final live-state refresh preserves the 60-day cohort provenance
